summary: Apollo Asset Backed Credit Company LLC filed an 8-K reporting routine unregistered sales of its shares to third-party investors under Regulation D and Regulation S exemptions, and disclosed its monthly transactional net asset value per share. The filing includes details of share issuance amounts and consideration but no special-situation event such as a merger, tender, or strategic review. It is a standard periodic disclosure for a closed-end fund or BDC.
